title: Αθήνα, Πειραιάς, Βουλιαγμένη — ανάγλυφο
projection: Same local equirectangular metres as athens.json; east +x, north +z.
order: row-major; row 0 is the southern edge (zMin), column 0 the western edge (xMin)
attribution: Υψόμετρα: Mapzen Terrain Tiles (AWS Open Data) · EU-DEM, Copernicus · SRTM, USGS
limitations: About 30 m source resolution; a surface model, so dense blocks and trees can lift the ground slightly; one 3x3 smoothing pass.
Sea depths are the source bathymetry; the renderer draws the sea surface at 0 m and the coastline where the relief crosses it.
